description: This file contains unit tests for the data asset management system, specifically testing copy operations to ensure unique IDs are handled correctly during server-side copying. It uses the xUnit testing framework and interacts with a REST API to create, copy, and verify assets.

classes.name: DbBackedCopyGeneratesUniqueIdsTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying that copying assets generates unique IDs and prevents conflicts by server-side overriding of IDs.

methods.name: Copy_canonical_overrides_target_ids_server_side_so_reusing_source_ids_does_not_conflict
methods.description: Tests copying an asset reusing source IDs, ensuring the server overrides IDs correctly to avoid conflicts.

methods.name: GetAssetAsync
methods.description: Helper method to fetch asset details by ID and verify the response.
